sections.heading: Cilia Flores — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Cilia Flores was born on 15 October 1956 in Tinaquillo, and holds citizenship of Venezuela. She was given the name Cilia Adela Flores at birth and is publicly known as Cilia Flores.
Her listed education includes Universidad Santa María.

sections.heading: Cilia Flores — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists politician and lawyer as her occupations.

She has held the following offices: member of the National Assembly of Venezuela (2000–2012), First Lady of Venezuela (2013–2026), member of the National Assembly of Venezuela (2016–2017), President of the National Assembly of Venezuela (2006–2011) and member of the Chamber of Deputies of Venezuela. She is affiliated with United Socialist Party of Venezuela.
